doc: Per-square exceptions to the generic square rules. Each entry is narrowly scoped to one id. The veto table (gate_check.VETO_TABLE, so VETO_TABLE_SHA256) is NOT changed and fakeText still applies in full to every live/<id>.png, including this square's: the live picture stays text-free. See handoff/32-square-inscription-exception.md.

daniel-5-1.decision: Owner ruling 2026-11-03: the Bible governs. The registry demand (writing on the wall) and the fakeText veto contradicted each other; the writing IS shown, as the real words of Daniel 5:25.

render.script: Imperial Aramaic (U+10840-U+10855), right-to-left, one glyph per Hebrew square-script consonant; no vowel points
render.layout: two lines, each read right to left, first line MENE MENE, second line TEKEL UPHARSIN
render.style: incised into the plaster, lit by the lampstand; pale gold edge glow (the registry already demands luminous)

daniel-5-1.live_picture_rule: live/daniel-5-1.png and candidates must show a disembodied hand and a BLANK, lit plaster wall area: no letters, no glyph-like strokes, no sparkle trails that read as writing. fakeText is judged on it exactly as for every other square.
daniel-5-1.registry_override: Show the glowing disembodied hand of Daniel 5:5 writing at the lampstand on the plaster wall of the king's palace, with a large, plain, evenly lit, EMPTY area of smooth plaster beside the fingertips. The wall area is deliberately blank: NO letters, NO glyphs, NO lines, NO carved or luminous strokes, NO sparkle trails. The real inscription is added later by a script.
